raw.observed: fine(1s/15s/30s): toto wins 8/8, 8/8, 7/8; 45s: timesfm 4, toto 3, chronos 1. coarse(1min): toto 3, chronos 2, ewma 2, timesfm 1 — chronos NOT majority
